svg.title: Figure 4. Threat, control, and evidence map
svg.desc: C1–C10 from threat to observation point, class, trace evidence, and metric. No row is a measured reduction.
svg.text: A control counts only with a class, an observation point, a mechanism, a protected property, a rerun on the same pairs, and a leftover list. Hosting a published mechanism does not transfer that paper’s measurements.

Restore log and rerun traces match the clean
baseline, or the difference is listed. A restore
that is not rerun is not recovery.
Attack success is the Stage 4 check holding on the Stage 5 trace. An attempted action is not that result.
C8 does not follow every C7 event. A memory read does not create the outbound call. If memory is waived, C7 and C8 are not applicable.
C4’s waiver is a scope decision, not evidence that the implementation was verified. C10’s recovery-rerun task success is not baseline TS and not protected TS.
DC is pre-commit flags over |A_m|. FN is no_flag cases over |A_m|. Post-commit cases are counted beside those rates and are not inside FN. FP is flags in B_m over |B_m|.
Each of DC, FN, and FP is undefined when its denominator is empty. not_monitored means the detector did not run. no_flag means it ran and did not flag. No row is a measured reduction.

svg.text: Green text is prevent. Purple text is detect. Amber text is respond, including a mixed class that responds. Teal text is recover. The class words are the authority if a row mixes classes. G3 checks Stage 6 scores only. DC, FN, and FP are Stage 7.
